TYPE: other
SUBJECT: A retro television test-card graphic showing horizontal rows of SMPTE-style color bars (white, yellow, cyan, green, magenta, red, blue) distorted with glitchy scanlines and color smearing. Centered across the middle is a solid black banner containing bold white pixelated block letters in the style of an old broadcast interruption card.
TEXT: PLEASE STAND BY
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: other
SUBJECT: A conceptual road-style sign mounted on a metal pole against a deep blue sky with scattered white clouds. The yellow rectangular sign has a metallic frame and two panels: the upper panel shows the word ORDER in clean black serif capitals, while the lower panel shows the word CHAOS in cracked, weathered black letters crossed out by a red diagonal stripe like a prohibition marking, contrasting order upheld and chaos forbidden.
TEXT: ORDER / CHAOS
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark studio-style portrait of a figure in a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie with hands clasped together at chest height against a black background. The head combines swooping blond hair recognizable as Donald Trump's with a Guy Fawkes / V for Vendetta mask covering the face, featuring rosy cheeks, a thin curled mustache, a pointed goatee, and a knowing smirk, rendered as a photomontage.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A night landscape over a valley city where thousands of warm street and house lights spread beneath silhouetted dark hills. Above, layered clouds glow amber near the horizon, and a brilliant green meteor or fireball streaks downward through the cloud deck, its luminous trail and glow illuminating the surrounding clouds, with a small bright star or planet visible in the upper left of the dark sky.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A satirical photomontage of a man recognizable as Joe Biden seated behind thick black jail bars in a wood-paneled cell, smiling broadly with hands clasped in his lap. He wears a bright orange inmate jumpsuit over a blue-and-white striped collared shirt, with a stenciled inmate number on the chest and a wristwatch on his left wrist; two large realistic gray rats flank him, one on a wooden bench at left and one at lower right, and a vertical artist watermark runs along the right edge.
TEXT: @Kalous (vertical watermark, right edge); partially legible inmate number stenciled on jumpsuit
SYMBOLS: numbers, clock

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A black-and-white photograph of Salvador Dali, identifiable by his dramatically upturned waxed mustache and wide, intense eyes, wearing a dark suit jacket, patterned tie, and white shirt with cufflinks. He gestures dynamically with one outstretched hand blurred in the foreground near a thin vertical cane or rod, posed before a backdrop of dense leafy foliage, framed with rounded vintage corners.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A conceptual 3D-rendered scene showing a large weathered white sign bolted to a bright red post in the foreground, displaying a small American flag graphic above bold distressed black capitals. Behind it, the United States Capitol building with its dome and broad staircase stands desaturated in grayscale under a heavy, overcast storm sky, the red post the only vivid color against the muted scene.
TEXT: GOVERNMENT / SHUTDOWN
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A fantasy digital painting of a colossal weathered stone portal with carved columns, a massive lintel, and a circular emblem on the right pillar, rising from rubble and mist. A small lone armored warrior stands on the stone steps at the threshold, facing a glowing blue-violet energy vortex inside the doorway that swirls with a serpentine bolt of lightning, while orange lightning forks through the dark storm clouds above and rain streaks over a wet, reflective ground.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: door, water

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A stylized digital art poster of Donald Trump depicted as a king, wearing an ornate gold crown, a red velvet cape trimmed with white spotted ermine fur, and a round presidential-seal medallion on his shoulder over a dark suit, blue shirt, and red tie. He grips a long glowing blue sword held horizontally across the frame with luminous engraved lettering along the blade, standing before a fiery orange apocalyptic sky with classical ruins and statuary at left, and large gold capitals spelling his name across the bottom above a small designer watermark.
TEXT: TWITTER LORD (repeated along sword blade) / TRUMP / DESIGN (stylized watermark, lower right)
SYMBOLS: trump

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A long-exposure night street scene of a red double-decker bus streaking across the frame as a horizontal motion blur, its windows and interior lights smeared into blue and white light trails against classical stone architecture lit by street lamps. The rain-soaked asphalt and pavement slabs in the foreground mirror the red and blue glow, with a traffic signal on a pole standing sharp in the middle ground showing a green light.
TEXT: NONE
